headline: The Skills area covers a set of ready-made skills shipped with the product plus the ability for users to manage and attach their own; the code confirms the built-in skill library, while the management screen and the skill picker could not be confirmed from the code reviewed.
what_is_there: There is a working mechanism that ships a packaged set of built-in skills and seeds them into the user's skill collection, keeping track of which ones have already been installed so they can be refreshed. One of the five named built-in skills is directly visible, and its numbering suggests the others sit alongside it.
what_is_unclear: The analysis could not confirm the skill management features — creating, editing and deleting user-defined skills — or the picker used to attach a skill to a task or chat. Both are referenced indirectly by the bookkeeping the built-in library relies on, but the code examined was a keyword-selected slice and did not include them.
suggested_action: Ask the team to point to where skill creation/editing and the skill picker live so those two tickets can be checked directly, and confirm all five built-in skills are present in the shipped library.
caveat: Some supporting documentation reviewed during the analysis was flagged as describing a different repository, so it carried no weight here.
